title: Fix 406: change ready counts only the change's own work after a rebase onto main
description: Fix 406: change ready counts only the change's own work after a rebase onto main
acceptance_criteria: On a branch rebased onto the default branch, or one that squash-merged it, after the change recorded its base, chough change ready names no file whose content at HEAD is the default branch's, and still names a file outside the declared paths that the change's own commits changed; with a base commit the repository does not have, it says so, naming it, prints no fatal: line, and counts from HEAD's merge base with the default branch.
